about: Camera spots for the walkable canal wharves (S2, u 20500-29050), in the one world frame (metres: X east, D north, H height; facing_deg 0 = +X east, 90 = north). Everything placed in the world comes from the scroll map through layout.json (tools/map_layout.mjs); this file only says where the camera can stand. Spots on the north bank stand on the built bank (the river plan's, gen/sections/canal/river_plan.json).

seam_west.about: just east of the S3 seam (u 20500) on the north bank strip: the slatted fence and its gateway, the two willows at the top, the shop row ahead, the north-bank cargo boat moored on the right

trackers.about: the five trackers hauling 逆水行舟's tow rope west along the bank under the split willow, the slat screen and the white wall behind them

terrace.about: the landing steps and the riverside dining terrace (沿河 terrace) with its diners, the long house's doors on the left, the hall behind the terrace

towed_boat.about: 逆水行舟 under tow with its mast on its cabin roof and the high-sided cargo boat beside it, from the unloading yard

scaffold_house.about: the plain-walled house with the pole scaffold on its ridge, its striped banner and swept mat awning over the stall, the sack porters on the yard

yanhe_yazuo.about: the open shop with its swagged curtain and goods racks, the signboard pole, 沿河雅座's raised room with its open windows, the warehouse beyond

wang_paper.about: 王家纸马铺 with its tall signboard and the stand piled with paper offerings, the far street running west under the willow

grain_wharf.about: the grain owner on his sacks, the sack heap and the porters carrying sacks up from the grain boats (私粮进京), the lower shed's tables on the left

grain_boats.about: the two deep-laden grain boats (万石船) and the bottom boat moored below the east wharf, the mooring stake and its coiled rope

fire_tower.about: the 望火楼: its brick platform, stair and pavilion over the rear shed, the gable-loft house and the willows behind the sheds

wanglou_shed.about: 望楼饭铺: the long thatched eating shed with its skirt roof, its customers, the donkey and the round-faced man at its east end

seam_east.about: just west of the S1 seam (u 29050) on the open ground in front of 望楼饭铺's east end, toward the village stalls

south_bank.about: on the south bank at the great willow's foot, across the river to the north-bank boats and shops
